title: Updating the guessed-code coordinate
statement: For any counting-algorithm state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, replacing coordinate $14$ of its register vector by $z$ yields the register vector of the state obtained by replacing its guessed code $g$ by $z$.
replaced:
Let a state be a tuple of 17 natural-number registers, in order: input length, halving
count, add-twice counter, window radius, code-bound exponent, code bound, doubling
scratch register, stage, stage plus one, known-ball size, outer vertex, next-ball count,
inner vertex, inner count, guessed code, current walk code, and walk step count. For any
such state σ and natural number z, replacing coordinate 14 of its associated vector
(with coordinates numbered from 0) by z gives the vector associated with the state
obtained by replacing its guessed-code register by z.
